name: b77_flat_v3
instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which intent does the message express? Pick the single best-fitting intent; specific cues (Apple Pay/Google Pay, contactless, virtual card, a small extra 1-unit charge) take priority over general ones.

criteria.activate_my_card: How to activate a card that has arrived, or the card cannot be activated.
criteria.age_limit: Minimum age to open or use an account; whether children or teenagers can have an account.
criteria.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Anything naming Apple Pay, Google Pay or a smartwatch wallet, including topping up through them or them not working.
criteria.atm_support: Where to find an ATM, which ATMs accept the card, whether the card can be used at ATMs in general.
criteria.automatic_top_up: The auto top-up feature: whether it exists, how to set it up or turn it off, how it works.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: A specific bank transfer (into the account, or one the customer made) has not shown up in the balance yet; also when the customer asks how long a transfer takes AND says the one they just made (e.g. from their UK account) is not showing yet.
criteria.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: A cheque or cash deposit (money the customer deposited) has not appeared in the balance yet or is taking long to clear.
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add a beneficiary / payee, or a beneficiary is not allowed or rejected.
criteria.cancel_transfer: Wants to cancel or reverse a transfer or payment they made (e.g. sent to the wrong account), or asks whether a transaction can be cancelled.
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card is expiring or has expired: how to get a replacement, what happens when it expires.
criteria.card_acceptance: Whether the card is accepted at shops/merchants/places, where it can be used for payments.
criteria.card_arrival: A card that was ordered has not arrived yet; tracking the card that was sent; the card is late.
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, when a new card will be delivered, delivery to a certain country, express or faster delivery.
criteria.card_linking: Linking or adding a card to the account or app, making a received card appear in the app, re-linking a found card.
criteria.card_not_working: The card does not work or is not working (in shops, at several places, or in general) without the customer saying a payment was declined; card broken or damaged.
criteria.card_payment_fee_charged: A fee was charged for a card payment or purchase; also vague complaints about hidden fees or too many fees, or fees on payments, even when no card is mentioned.
criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment or purchase on the statement that the customer says they did not make or do not recognise (worded as a payment or purchase).
criteria.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: A card purchase abroad or in a foreign currency got the wrong or a bad exchange rate.
criteria.card_swallowed: An ATM kept, retained or swallowed the card.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_charge: A fee charged for withdrawing cash at an ATM; whether ATM withdrawals cost money.
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash withdrawal on the account that the customer did not make or does not recognise.
criteria.change_pin: How to change or reset the PIN, where to set the PIN, whether the card has a PIN.
criteria.compromised_card: Suspects someone else has the card details or is using the card; card details stolen; fraud on the card (not physical loss).
criteria.contactless_not_working: Contactless payments (tap to pay) do not work.
criteria.country_support: Which countries the bank/service or account is available in; using the service from or moving to another country.
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment or purchase was explicitly declined or rejected, or the card was declined in a shop, online or at a restaurant.
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal at an ATM was declined or not authorised; cannot withdraw cash.
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined or the customer is told they cannot make a transfer.
criteria.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer does not recognise; also a vague unknown or unauthorised charge, or wanting to dispute a charge, when it is not described as a purchase.
criteria.disposable_card_limits: Limits or restrictions of disposable virtual cards: how many uses, maximum amount.
criteria.edit_personal_details: Change or update personal details: name, address, phone, email, account details.
criteria.exchange_charge: Fees or extra charges for exchanging currencies; is there an exchange fee.
criteria.exchange_rate: What exchange rate is used, where to see exchange rates, how rates are set, current rate for a currency.
criteria.exchange_via_app: How to exchange or convert currencies in the app; which currencies can be exchanged.
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: A specific small extra amount on the statement, such as an extra 1 pound, 1 dollar or 1 euro charge or fee, even if the customer says they do not recognise it or it is pending; also asking what extra charges or an extra fee on the statement are.
criteria.failed_transfer: A transfer failed or did not go through; money from a failed transfer.
criteria.fiat_currency_support: Which currencies the account can hold, receive or pay in; whether a particular currency is supported.
criteria.get_disposable_virtual_card: How to get or create a disposable virtual card; who can get one.
criteria.get_physical_card: Getting a physical (plastic) card; where to find the PIN for a new physical card.
criteria.getting_spare_card: Getting an additional, second or spare card (e.g. for family), and its cost.
criteria.getting_virtual_card: How to get, order or find a (non-disposable) virtual card; whether virtual cards are available.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The card was lost or stolen (physically), card missing, freezing or blocking a lost card, found a lost card.
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The phone was lost, stolen or left somewhere; using the account without the phone.
criteria.order_physical_card: Ordering a physical card, cost of a card, how to order a new card in general.
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgot the app passcode or login code, resetting the passcode, cannot log in.
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment or purchase is still pending; how long pending payments take.
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is pending or shows as in progress (including when the ATM failed to give cash).
criteria.pending_top_up: A top-up is still pending, slow, the customer is not sure it went through, or the topped-up funds are not available yet.
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer the customer sent is still pending, in progress, or they have been waiting a long time for it to complete.
criteria.pin_blocked: The PIN is blocked or the card/account is locked after entering the wrong PIN too many times.
criteria.receiving_money: How to receive money, whether others can send money to the customer, receiving salary.
criteria.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund the customer is expecting has not appeared in the account yet.
criteria.request_refund: Wants a refund for something bought; how to get a refund.
criteria.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment that was reverted, cancelled, returned or refunded back to the account, or refused by the merchant / not accepted after being made.
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Which card types (credit/debit, issuing countries) or currencies can be used, especially for topping up; supported cards.
criteria.terminate_account: Close, delete or terminate the account.
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Fees for topping up by bank transfer.
criteria.top_up_by_card_charge: Fees for topping up with a card.
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up or depositing with cash or a cheque: whether and how.
criteria.top_up_failed: A top-up was declined, errored or did not go through, including the card being declined when topping up.
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-ups: maximum amount, how often, how much can be topped up.
criteria.top_up_reverted: A top-up that seemed to go through was then reverted, returned or cancelled, or the topped-up money disappeared (no card mentioned).
criteria.topping_up_by_card: How to top up using a card; also a top-up by card where the money then disappeared.
criteria.transaction_charged_twice: The same transaction or payment was charged twice / duplicated.
criteria.transfer_fee_charged: A fee was charged for a transfer; also a bare one-line 'why was I charged?' or 'will I get extra charges?' that names no product, amount or statement entry.
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer or add money into the account from another bank account; adding funds.
criteria.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: A transfer the customer sent has not arrived at the recipient (the payee/friend/landlord does not have it), or it is taking too long to reach them.
criteria.transfer_timing: Purely general questions about how long transfers take, e.g. how long a transfer from the US or Europe takes, with no specific missing transfer described.
criteria.unable_to_verify_identity: Identity verification failed or the customer cannot complete it.
criteria.verify_my_identity: How to verify identity: process, documents needed, how long it takes.
criteria.verify_source_of_funds: Verifying or showing the source of funds / where the money came from.
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up or a top-up card: the verification code, how top-up verification works.
criteria.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual card (including a disposable virtual card) does not work or is refused.
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Whether the card is Visa or Mastercard; wanting a specific card network.
criteria.why_verify_identity: Why identity verification is needed or why so much personal information is asked for.
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: The ATM gave less or a different amount of cash than requested or charged.
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal abroad got the wrong exchange rate.
